The vulnerability is in `src/logging.ts`. The `PrintLogs` function reads `.vdf` files (which include Steam's `config.vdf` containing authentication tokens) and prints their full contents to job output logs via `core.info()`, without filtering for sensitive data.

The `.vdf` extension is explicitly included in the file filter at line 29, and `config.vdf` is not in the exclusion list (lines 8-15). The `config.vdf` file in Steam's config directory contains authentication tokens such as `LoginSteamID`, `LoginUsername`, and session tokens.

<final_answer>
src/logging.ts:29 (the regex `/\.(log|txt|vdf)$/` matches `.vdf` files including config.vdf which contains authentication tokens)
src/logging.ts:32 (reads the full content of the .vdf file into logContent)
src/logging.ts:34 (prints the file content via core.info() which writes to job output logs, leaking any authentication tokens present)
</final_answer>
